'''Pritch''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]]
of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Pritch was [[Darth Baras]]'s minion and was stationed in [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas's]] [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]], overseeing the [[Dromund Kaas rebellion]].

==Biography==
A [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], Pritch served in the [[Imperial Army (Sith Empire)|Imperial Army]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], a proxy conflict between the Empire and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="TOR" /> During the [[Dromund Kaas rebellion]], he was stationed near the [[Unfinished colossus]] under the command of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Baras]],<ref name="TOR2" /> the secret architect of the revolt.<ref name="TOR" />

Around [[3643 BBY]], Darth Baras assigned his new [[Empire's Wrath|apprentice]] to Pritch for a mission in Dromund Kaas' [[Jungle/Legends|jungles]]. There, Pritch requested the assistance of the [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith apprentice]] to eliminate several [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] [[Captain/Legends|captains]] who threatened to reveal Darth Baras' role in the slave rebellion unless they were supplied with better weaponry. After disposing of several rebel leaders, the Apprentice returned to Pritch who thanked him for his service.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander Pritch first appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online roleplaying game|MMORPG]] produced by [[BioWare]]. In the game, Pritch is featured on Dromund Kaas during the [[Sith Warrior]]'s class quest "Pull the Plug". During the mission, the player has either the option of killing the slaves or finding evidence to blackmail the slave captains of their involvement in selling their own people back into slavery, an idea Pritch offers as an alternative to killing them.
